_comment: AWS credential templates. Note: for production use, prefer OIDC/SSO via aws-vault or aws sso. These templates are for direct access key + secret pairs.

aws_env.name: aws_env
aws_env.description: Inject AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID and AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY as env vars
aws_env._note: This template uses one credential for two values. For real AWS, store them as separate credentials (aws/access_key_id and aws/secret_access_key) and use the composite pattern below.

aws_sso_env.name: aws_sso_env
aws_sso_env.description: Inject AWS SSO credentials (access key + secret + session token)
aws_sso_env._note: Same caveat as aws_env — store three separate credentials in real use.

aws_config_file.name: aws_config_file
aws_config_file.cli: harness vault template add aws/profile --name aws_config_file --file /tmp/harness-aws-credentials
